question: Why was the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel made with 60% oil sludge?
rendered: According to the text, the corn straw–oil sludge composite fuel was made with a mass ratio of 1.5:1 (60/40, w/w) of corn straw to oil sludge. This was based on the authors' previous pelletization study.
